reason: Adds a DSH Web GUI tab that visualizes and explains assistant activity by user round, with rules-based summaries and optional host-LLM narratives.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 中按用户轮次展示助手的需求、执行过程、错误和结果，并可调用主机 LLM 生成过程解读。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Web GUI tab that presents assistant needs, actions, errors, and results by user round, with optional process narratives generated through the host LLM.

capabilities: Adds a trajectory interpretation tab to the DSH web conversation interface
Segments conversation activity by user round and displays action summaries, errors, replies, and tool-call details
Sends selected round material to the host LLM service for optional narrative generation
Caches generated interpretations by material hash
